raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: cartopy
  version: "0.25.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 55f1a390e5f3f075b221c7d91fb10258ad978db786c7930eba06eb45d28753fe

build:
  number: 3
  dynamic_linking:
    overlinking_behavior: error
  python:
    entry_points:
      - feature_download = tools.cartopy_feature_download.py:__main__

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
        - numpy
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77.0.3
    - setuptools-scm >=8.0.0
    - cython >=0.29.24
    - numpy
  run:
    - python
    - matplotlib-base >=3.6
    - shapely >=2.0
    - packaging >=21
    - pyshp >=2.3
    - pyproj >=3.3.1

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - cartopy
        - cartopy.mpl.geoaxes
        - cartopy.crs
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -c "import cartopy.crs as ccrs; import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; ax = plt.axes(projection=ccrs.PlateCarree())"
      - python run_test.py
    files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py

about:
  homepage: http://scitools.org.uk/cartopy
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A library providing cartographic tools for python
  repository: https://github.com/SciTools/cartopy
  documentation: https://scitools.org.uk/cartopy/docs/latest/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ocefpaf
    - pelson
    - dopplershift
    - xylar
    - akrherz
